visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wears a bright blue textured hooded jacket outdoors. He stands against a backdrop of tall glass buildings and a clear blue sky, speaking directly to the camera while gesturing. Yellow and white Chinese text is centered on the screen. (2) The scene transitions to the interior of a brightly lit salon named Headline Salon, featuring warm wood flooring and several styling stations with large mirrors. The man is now indoors, wearing a grey patterned sweater, and a woman in a red and white patterned knit sweater appears briefly next to him. (3) The man lies horizontally in a black hair-washing basin. A female staff member in a white t-shirt and black apron applies white soapy foam to his hair, massaging his scalp. His eyes are covered with a white protective mask. Purple hair rollers are visible nearby. (4) A male staff member in a white cardigan with a small bee emblem stands in the salon, smiling and gesturing with his hands as he speaks to the camera. The background shows professional hair styling equipment and a clean, modern aesthetic. (5) Back at the styling station, the man wears a large white cape and a clear plastic face shield. The female stylist uses silver clippers to trim the back of his neck and scissors to shape the top of his hair. Small dark hair clippings are scattered across the white cape. (6) The stylist uses a pink and grey Dyson hair dryer to style the man's damp hair. He holds a smartphone to monitor the process. The final phase shows the man smiling at the camera, displaying his new short, styled haircut from various angles as text overlays display the price.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 male creator (A-Xiang), 1 female partner (Zoe), 1 male salon manager, 1 female stylist, and 1 female hair washer.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A-Xiang: Male, short black hair, wearing a blue hooded jacket then a grey sweater. Zoe: Female, long dark hair, wearing a white furry hat and a red/white patterned sweater.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video starts on a busy Seoul street with modern skyscrapers and a clear sky. It moves into a professional hair salon (Headline Salon) with a wood-heavy interior, large mirrors, black leather chairs, and various hair treatment machines.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop BGM with a strong 4-on-the-floor electronic beat begins. A male voice (A-Xiang) speaks with a bright, friendly tone and moderate speed. (2) Ambient sound shifts to an indoor room tone as a female voice (Zoe) joins with high-arousal cheerful intonation. Intermittent laughter is heard. (3) Sound of rhythmic water splashing and head scrubbing occurs, accompanied by a 'pop' cartoon sound effect. The BGM ducks slightly to favor the splashing noise. (4) A middle-aged male voice enters, speaking Mandarin with a clear, resonant pitch. The BGM continues with a steady electronic synth melody. (5) Mechanical buzzing of hair clippers and the metallic 'clink' of scissors are prominent. These sounds are punctuated by digital 'ding' and comedic UI sound effects. (6) A loud, high-pitched whirring sound from a hair dryer dominates the mix for several seconds. The BGM swells in volume toward the end. A-Xiang's voice returns with rising intonation to ask a concluding question.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience Journey -> Outcome -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's personal experience of getting a haircut in a Korean salon. It aims to inform viewers about the cost, quality of service, and the unique interaction with a Mandarin-speaking staff member, while seeking audience engagement on the final look and value for money.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed display of salon name, service process, and positive commentary on the tea and haircut quality.
